signal_receiver.name: Signal Receiver
signal_receiver.description: A repaired narrow-band receiver. A faint repeating carrier is present near the roadside service cabinet.

carrier_note.name: Carrier Note
carrier_note.description: MARA / 06:40: The carrier repeats every eleven seconds. Riggs heard it too. Follow the utility line. Never bridge a live cabinet by hand.

route_map.name: Route Map
route_map.description: Black Creek → Milepost Repair → stranded EV → solar storage → substation. Scout the elevated relay before drawing power.

residents.name: Riggs
residents.line: Most of this road died one bearing at a time. Bring me steel and I will put cutters in your hand.
residents.rumor: Keep a wrench. Seized motors still hold copper, magnets and bearings.

residents.name: Vee
residents.line: I ride when the towers stop humming. Nobody owns the shoulder. Trade wire for a working cell?
residents.rumor: Fuel is worth stopping for. Search maintenance yards, but save room in the trailer.

residents.name: Inez
residents.line: We patch the pipes before we patch the roofs. The river keeps us here. I can spare rubber for steel.
residents.rumor: Cal knows the intake. If the breakers refuse you, find the maintenance note before trying again.

residents.name: Sol
residents.line: Every working board here came out of something someone threw away. Copper buys you two assemblies.
residents.rumor: A dead laptop is a battery and a control board waiting for a screwdriver.

residents.name: Ada
residents.line: The security relays never got the shutdown order. I keep one reserve for riders heading north.
residents.rumor: Scout the security corridor. The engineer drone can reach switches a rider cannot.

residents.name: Kip
residents.line: There is a person behind that transmission. I heard them stop to breathe. Spare wire? I have scrap.
residents.rumor: The last bank can light the camps or carry a message farther. That choice belongs to whoever gets there.
